from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/isomedia/box_code_meta.c')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
for idx,l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.strip()=='GF_Err bxml_box_read(GF_Box *s, GF_BitStream *bs)':
        lines[idx+2:idx+2]=['        if (ptr->size > gf_bs_available(bs)) return GF_ISOM_INCOMPLETE_FILE;']
        break
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
sed -n '206,218p' src/isomedia/box_code_meta.c
